item.title: BondMedia 0.3.3
item.description: • Ratings look like they did before 0.3.0 again: a star for the TMDB score and a tomato for Rotten Tomatoes. A rotten score (below 60%) now shows a green splat instead of the tomato.

item.title: BondMedia 0.3.2
item.description:
• Watch Together: pausing, resuming and skipping from the Picture in Picture window now reaches everyone in the group, not just you.
  • Fixed a crash when opening the player's audio and subtitles panel (most often in full screen or a small window).

item.title: BondMedia 0.3.1
item.description: • Watch Together: Create Group now shows that it's working and ignores repeat clicks while a busy server takes its time, so you no longer end up creating a group per click. If the server answers late, BondMedia waits for the group instead of reporting a timeout.

item.title: BondMedia 0.3.0
item.description:
• Headphone Surround: 5.1 and 7.1 soundtracks are placed around you in any wired or USB headphones (a virtual speaker room built on MIT KEMAR measurements) instead of being folded into flat stereo. Turn it on in the player's audio panel (⌘S) or in Settings → Audio & Video.
  • Fix Match for server admins: if a title got the wrong poster or details, pick the right one from TMDB (search by title and year, or paste an IMDb ID or TMDB link). Right-click a card, or use the ⋯ button on its page.
  • Ratings now say where they come from: TMDB and Rotten Tomatoes chips on title pages and Home.
  • Add Account lists your saved servers first, so another user can sign in to the same server in two clicks.
  • Settings are one click away: a gear next to your account in the sidebar, and a Settings item in the account menu.
  • Acknowledgements: the open-source components BondMedia is built on, with their licenses (Settings → General).

item.title: BondMedia 0.2.8
item.description: Episode cards in Up Next and Search now show the show's title art instead of a frame from the episode. Movies without key art get their title logo over the backdrop.

item.title: BondMedia 0.2.7
item.description: The player panel no longer jumps sideways when you pick a scale, zoom or speed in the Video tab. The Extended buffer now reads at least 5 minutes ahead (was 10).

item.title: BondMedia 0.2.6
item.description: - Fixed: with many audio or subtitle tracks, the player's Audio/Subtitles panel ran past the window. Long lists now scroll and open on the selected track.

item.title: BondMedia 0.2.5
item.description: - Fixed: after changing the language, Relaunch left the old window running (and it ignored ⌘Q). It now quits and reopens cleanly. - Quitting can no longer hang: if saving the playback position stalls, the app still quits within 3 seconds.

item.title: BondMedia 0.2.4
item.description: - Series pages: seasons are now the heading of the episode list, with a count of episodes left. Hide Spoilers moved into the ⋯ menu. - Download Season is a round button next to Favorites and shows which season it will download. - Smoother scrolling through long episode lists. - The timeline's time preview now floats above the bar instead of covering it; the bar thickens less on hover. - Library grids no longer hide their last column, and the A–Z bar stays clear of always-visible scroll bars. - Clearer buffer settings: the values are minimums (files with rare keyframes buffer further ahead). - Tooltips on Play, Resume and Trailer.

item.title: BondMedia 0.2.3
item.description:
• New compact player controls with volume and 10-second skips
  • The timeline's time bubble no longer covers the bar
  • The sidebar always opens and widens fully, with nothing cut off
  • No dark band over the Home hero when the pointer reaches the toolbar

item.title: BondMedia 0.2.2
item.description: • The sidebar can be made as narrow as before again

item.title: BondMedia 0.2.1
item.description:
• The Play/Resume button on series pages is now translated
  • English is used when macOS is set to neither English nor Russian
  • Sidebar labels no longer get cut off

item.title: BondMedia 0.2.0
item.description:
• Automatic updates
  • Offline downloads
  • Up Next with a watchlist
  • Your chosen dub is remembered for the whole series
  • Sleep timer
  • Episode pages with file details
  • Instant movie pages and actor biographies
